title: DC Comics Presents Superman #1 2004 Julie Schwartz Tribute Stan Lee Darwyn Cooke
condition_description: Reading copy: back cover has peeling/chipping along the right edge and scuffing; small spot at the left edge of the front cover. See photos.
description:
DC Comics Presents: Superman #1 (October 2004), DC Comics - one-shot Julie Schwartz tribute, "Secret of the Phantom Quarterback!" Stories by Stan Lee, Paul Levitz, Darwyn Cooke, Keith Giffen, J. Bone and Al Milgrom. Direct sales, $2.50 cover price.

Back cover: got milk? ad.

Condition: reading copy. The back cover has peeling and chipping along the right edge plus scuffing, and there is a small spot at the left edge of the front cover (see close-up photos). Interior intact.

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
